summary: First requests on a clean database can fail with 500: demo user created per request (users_pkey race)
description:
Source: DFMEA 2026-11-04 (F01). Confirmed: `_authenticated_user` (`api/app.py:231`) does `db.get` then `db.add` / `commit`. The UI fires several requests at startup, and on a fresh database two can race and one gets `UniqueViolation` → 500. On a new team laptop that's the first thing they see.

**Fix:** seed the demo user once in the app lifespan with `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING`; the request dependency only reads.

**Acceptance:** a test with 20 concurrent first requests against an empty `users` table, all returning 200.

comments.body: [devin] PR #70 up for review: https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/70 — demo user seeded once in the lifespan (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, dialect-aware); request dependency is a pure read. Test: 20 concurrent first requests on empty users table, all 200.
